coverage: 21 source fixtures, five separate relation caches, cold A→B, immediate repeated A→B, B→A, A→A; full diagnostics, native ternaries and observed before/after state
endpoints: Setup includes source semantic graph and per-mode checker creation; relation interval begins before first cold action and includes all four actions/lazy resolution. Separate setup/relation requested traffic and live backing. Keep graph/results alive at after-checkpoints; raw before/after endpoint recording is mandatory.
execution: Fresh checker per mode, source types resolved immediately before that group, no display/diagnostics prewarming. Build required generic, signature and lazy member machinery; relations that create types must create them during the operation. Display and independent diagnostic validation follow, outside relation timing.
forbidden: sealing/pre-resolving lazy graphs to bypass relation allocations
new unsafe, lifetime transmute or leaked graph storage
implementations: tools/s08/relater-prototype: isolated stable arena reference/interior mutability algorithm
proof: P1 records safe construction and mutation scopes, retained graph/result ownership and failure behavior before building the full reference alternative.

sampling.fixed_work: one ordered pass of all fixture/mode groups per fresh process; aggregate separately measured setup and relation intervals. If timer resolution is inadequate, report unavailable and review a protocol amendment before collecting comparison results; no result-dependent repeat count.
sampling.stability: Same max/min > 1.10 flag and complete-batch retention as checker-workload.json; no selective omission or automatic extension

scope: Supplemental isolated relater contract; never changes E2 primary denominator
state_comparison: Boolean and ternary outcomes, ordered diagnostics, cache flag multisets and cold/repeat allocation/resolution transitions. Do not compare raw native TypeIds. Native type/signature/instantiation counts are semantic diagnostic expectations; explain any representation-only count difference explicitly rather than normalizing it silently.
verdict: Parity first, then one complete measured comparison. An unfavorable valid result meets the experiment obligation, but does not authorize production promotion.
